The intensity I of the sound at a distance r from the car horn in (b) is given by the expression I = k / r², where k is a constant.
Fig. 4.2 shows the car in (b) on a road.

An observer stands at point O. Initially the car is parked at point X which is 120 m away from point O. The car then moves directly towards the observer and stops at point Y, a distance of 30 m away from O. The car horn continuously emits sound when the car is moving between points X and Y.
parts.text:
The sound wave at point O has amplitude $A_{\mathrm{X}}$ when the car is at X and has amplitude $A_{\mathrm{Y}}$ when the car is at Y.
Calculate the ratio $\frac{A_{\mathrm{Y}}}{A_{\mathrm{X}}}$.
